 "data": "---
title: Datenmodell NoteFieber (Stand 03.11.2026, maßgeblich ist database/scripts/schema/schema.sql)
---
erDiagram

 PAGES |o--o{ IMPORT_ITEMS : \"entstand aus\"
 TENANTS {
 uuid id PK \"gleiche ID wie in TalkFieber\"
 text slug UK
 text name
 text region
 text plan
 text idp_org_id UK \"Organisation in Zitadel\"
 timestamptz created_at
 timestamptz deleted_at
 }
 USERS {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 text idp_subject UK \"Person in Zitadel\"
 text email \"eindeutig pro Mandant\"
 text display_name
 text role \"org_admin, member\"
 boolean is_external
 text locale
 text time_zone
 uuid avatar_file_id FK
 timestamptz deactivated_at
 }
 WORKSPACES {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 text slug \"eindeutig pro Mandant\"
 text name
 timestamptz archived_at
 }
 WORKSPACE_MEMBERS {
 uuid workspace_id PK,FK
 uuid user_id PK,FK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 text role \"owner, admin, member, guest\"
 timestamptz joined_at
 }
 GROUPS {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 text idp_group_id \"eindeutig pro Mandant\"
 text name
 }
 GROUP_MEMBERS {
 uuid group_id PK,FK
 uuid user_id PK,FK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 }
 INVITES {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 uuid workspace_id FK
 text email
 text role \"admin, member, guest\"
 text token_hash UK \"nur der Hash\"
 timestamptz expires_at
 timestamptz accepted_at
 timestamptz revoked_at
 }
 SPACES {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 uuid workspace_id FK
 text key \"z. B. ENTW, eindeutig pro Mandant\"
 text name
 text description
 uuid home_page_id FK \"Startseite\"
 uuid created_by FK
 timestamptz archived_at \"archiviert = nur lesbar\"
 }
 PAGES {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 uuid space_id FK
 uuid parent_id FK \"im selben Space\"
 ltree path \"vom Trigger gesetzt\"
 text position \"Fractional Index\"
 text title \"bis 255 Zeichen\"
 boolean inherit_perms \"false = eigene Rechte\"
 uuid created_by FK
 uuid updated_by FK
 timestamptz updated_at
 timestamptz deleted_at \"Papierkorb\"
 uuid trash_root_id \"gemeinsam gelöscht mit\"
 }
 PAGE_CONTENTS {
 uuid page_id PK,FK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 bytea ydoc \"Yjs-Zustand\"
 text plain_text
 uuid_array editors_since_version
 timestamptz updated_at
 }
 PAGE_VERSIONS {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 uuid page_id FK
 integer version \"fortlaufend pro Seite\"
 text kind \"auto, manual, restore, import\"
 integer restored_from
 text title
 bytea ydoc
 text plain_text
 uuid_array author_ids
 uuid created_by FK
 timestamptz created_at
 }
 PAGE_SEARCH {
 uuid page_id PK,FK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 uuid space_id
 tsvector tsv
 }
 PAGE_LINKS {
 uuid from_page_id PK,FK
 uuid to_page_id PK,FK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 }
 GRANTS {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 uuid space_id FK \"entweder Space\"
 uuid page_id FK \"oder Seite\"
 text subject_type \"user, group, workspace\"
 uuid user_id FK
 uuid group_id FK
 text role \"viewer, commenter, editor, admin\"
 }
 COMMENTS {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 uuid page_id FK
 uuid parent_id FK \"eine Ebene tief\"
 uuid author_id FK
 text body \"beim Löschen NULL\"
 jsonb anchor \"relative Yjs-Position\"
 timestamptz resolved_at
 uuid resolved_by FK
 timestamptz deleted_at
 }
 FILES {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 uuid page_id FK \"leer bei Profilbild und Import\"
 uuid uploaded_by FK
 text storage_key UK \"Objekt in Garage\"
 text file_name
 text mime
 bigint size_bytes
 text scan_status \"pending, clean, infected, error\"
 }
 IMPORTS {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 uuid space_id FK
 text source \"confluence\"
 uuid file_id FK
 text status \"pending, running, done, failed, rolled_back\"
 boolean dry_run
 jsonb report
 uuid created_by FK
 }
 IMPORT_ITEMS {
 uuid import_id PK,FK
 text source_id PK \"Confluence-ID\"
 uuid tenant_id FK
 uuid page_id FK
 text status \"done, skipped, placeholder, failed\"
 }
 OUTBOX {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 text subject \"t.tenant.wiki.s.space\"
 text event_type
 jsonb payload
 timestamptz published_at
 }
 AUDIT_LOG {
 uuid id PK
 uuid tenant_id FK
 uuid actor_id
 text action
 text target_type
 uuid target_id
 jsonb details
 timestamptz created_at
 }
